## Goal
- Build a minimal Ruby on Rails 8.1.3 SPA chat application using RubyLLM with Claude Sonnet via OpenRouter, styled with Tailwind CSS and Hotwire (Stimulus/Turbo), without Active Record

## Constraints & Preferences
- Ruby 4.0.5, Rails 8.1.3 via mise
- No Active Record, Action Mailer, or Active Job
- Tailwind CSS + Hotwire/Stimulus/Turbo Streams only
- API keys via environment variables (source ~/.config/zsh/secrets)
- Zero secrets in repo, .env, Dockerfiles, or README examples
- Minitest unit tests for all components
- CI: Brakeman, RuboCop, SimpleCov, bundle-audit
- Phase 1 of 2: implementation, tests, structure only
- Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml required
- No authentication; ChatGPT-like minimal web interface

## Progress
### Done
- Initialized Rails 8.1.3 app with --skip-active-record --skip-action-mailer --skip-active-job
- Updated Gemfile: added hotwire-rails, ruby_llm (~> 1.16), simplecov, updated dev/test gems
- Installed bundle dependencies
- Configured Stimulus + Turbo via importmap (app/javascript/application.js, config/importmap.rb)
- Created config/initializers/ruby_llm.rb with OpenRouter provider configuration
- Created app/services/chat_service.rb with ChatService, ChatConversation, ChatMessage classes
- Created app/controllers/conversations_controller.rb (index, create, show, message actions)
- Created app/models/message_form.rb
- Updated config/routes.rb with routes for conversations
- Created app/views/layouts/application.html.erb (dark theme layout, header, main)
- Created app/views/conversations/index.html.erb (landing page with prompt suggestions)
- Created app/views/conversations/show.html.erb (chat display)

### In Progress
- Creating app/views/conversations/_message.html.erb partial

### Blocked
- Message partial write failed (invalid JSON in tool arguments)
- OPENROUTER_API_KEY unavailable (secrets file not found)

## Key Decisions
- Use `ruby_llm` gem (v1.16.0) for LLM integration instead of `rubyllm`
- Model: `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250514` via OpenRouter
- In-memory conversation storage via ChatService (no database)
- Turbo Streams for streaming responses
- Importmap + Stimulus for JavaScript (no Node/npm build step)

## Next Steps
- Complete app/views/conversations/_message.html.erb partial
- Create Stimulus controllers (conversation controller for wizard suggestions, message controller for sending)
- Create Turbo stream responses for streaming chat
- Create app/views/conversations/message_stream.turbo_stream.erb
- Write Minitest tests for ChatService
- Configure RuboCop, Brakeman, SimpleCov, bundle-audit
- Create README.md, Dockerfile, and docker-compose.yml
- Run bundle install + verify setup

- mise installed: Ruby 4.0.5, Rails 8.1.3
- Gemfile uses: propshaft, puma, importmap-rails, tailwindcss-rails, hotwire-rails, ruby_llm, bootsnap, kamal, thruster
- Turbo/Stimulus pins: @hotwired/turbo-rails, @hotwired/stimulus, @hotwired/stimulus-loading
- RubyLLM initializer configures provider to :open_router with ENV["OPENROUTER_API_KEY"]
- ChatService uses Thread for async LLM responses
- Model ID: "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250514"
